Here are the step-by-step solutions for each problem:

- **[id 150]**: Steve travels $3 \times 5280 = 15840\text{ ft}$ at $440\text{ ft/min}$, taking $36\text{ min}$. Tim travels $2 \times 5280 = 10560\text{ ft}$ at $264\text{ ft/min}$, taking $40\text{ min}$. Waiting time is $40 - 36 = 4\text{ minutes}$.
- **[id 151]**: Total tires inflated = $(5 \times 2) + (3 \times 3) + (1 \times 1) = 10 + 9 + 1 = 20\text{ tires}$. At $\$0.25$ per tire, earnings = $20 \times 0.25 = 5\text{ dollars}$.
- **[id 152]**: Total cookies = $10 \times 6 = 60$. Total cost = $60 \times \$0.10 = \$6.00$. Change from $\$10 = 10 - 6 = 4\text{ dollars}$.
- **[id 153]**: Dave ate 14. Seagull ate $14 / 2 = 7$. Pigeons ate $3 \times 3 = 9$. After raccoon took $2/3$, $1/3$ remained. Ants took 1 leaving 5, so $1/3$ remainder was $5 + 1 = 6$. Total before raccoon was $6 \times 3 = 18$. Initial pack = $14 + 7 + 9 + 18 = 48\text{ fries}$.
- **[id 154]**: Mon/Wed/Fri: $3 \times 1\text{ hr} \times 3\text{ days} = 9\text{ hrs/wk} \times 16\text{ wks} = 144\text{ hrs}$. Tue/Thu: $2 \times 2\text{ hrs} \times 2\text{ days} = 8\text{ hrs/wk} \times 16\text{ wks} = 128\text{ hrs}$. Total = $144 + 128 = 272\text{ hours}$.
- **[id 155]**: Rolls = $300 \times 4\text{ in} = 1200\text{ in}$. Croissants = $120 \times 6\text{ in} = 720\text{ in}$. Together = $(1200 + 720) / 12 = 160\text{ ft}$. Baguettes = $60 \times 2\text{ ft} = 120\text{ ft}$. Total = $160 + 120 = 280\text{ feet}$.
- **[id 156]**: Monthly consumption = $200 + 400 + 100 = 700\text{ bananas}$. For 2 months = $700 \times 2 = 1400\text{ bananas}$.
- **[id 157]**: Blake: $15 \times (100 \times 2) = 3000\text{ yards}$. Kelly: $(1 \times 200) + 34 \times (40 \times 2) = 200 + 2720 = 2920\text{ yards}$. Difference = $3000 - 2920 = 80\text{ yards}$.
- **[id 158]**: Pens: $4 \times \$1.5 = \$6$. Notebooks: $2 \times \$4 = \$8$. Bond paper: $\$20$. Total = $6 + 8 + 20 = 34\text{ dollars}$.
- **[id 159]**: Tadpoles visible = $11 + 6 - 2 = 15$.
